nodes.description: address private owner; privileged address set to msg.sender in constructor and used as the only access-control gate
mapping(address=>uint) public balanceOf; token balances written unchecked in transferFrom and batchSend
mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint)) public allowance; spending approvals, decremented unchecked in transferFrom
address tradeAddress; whitelisted trading address used inside ensure
mapping(address=>uint256) private _onSaleNum; per-address sale counter incremented on every transferFrom
mapping(address=>bool) private canSale; whitelist flag consulted by ensure
uint256 private _minSale; minimum sale amount, set in init as token*(10**decimals)
uint256 private _maxSale; maximum sale amount, set in init as maxToken*(10**decimals)
uint256 private _saleNum; number of allowed sales per address, set in init
uint public totalSupply; minted once in the constructor
string public name; token name
string public symbol; token symbol
uint constant public decimals = 18; used as an exponent in init
address constant UNI (Uniswap V2 router); compared against _from in ensure
constructor(string,string,uint256) payable: mints total supply to msg.sender, sets owner and unlimited allowance to the Uniswap router
transfer(address _to, uint _value) public payable: simply forwards msg.sender to transferFrom
transferFrom(address _from,address _to,uint _value) public payable: unchecked allowance/balance arithmetic, whitelist via ensure, increments _onSaleNum
approve(address _spender, uint _value) public payable: sets arbitrary allowance for msg.sender
ensure(address _from,address _to,uint _value) internal view: whitelist gate that bypasses condition() for owner/UNI/tradeAddress/canSale addresses
condition(address _from,uint _value) internal view: sale-count and min/max sale-amount checks
delegate(address a, bytes b) public payable: owner-gated delegatecall to an arbitrary address and calldata
init(uint256 saleNum,uint256 token,uint256 maxToken) public: owner-gated configuration of sale limits
batchSend(address[] _tos, uint _value) public payable: owner-gated loop distributing tokens, unchecked multiplication and accumulation
setTradeAddress(address addr) public: owner-gated write of the whitelisted tradeAddress
pairFor(address factory,address tokenA,address tokenB) internal pure: CREATE2 address derivation for the Uniswap pair
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used for allowance accounting, owner assignment and all access-control checks
a.delegatecall(b) in delegate(): arbitrary delegatecall executed in the token's storage context
allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value, balanceOf[_from] -= _value, balanceOf[_to] += _value in transferFrom: raw unchecked arithmetic
uint total = _value * _tos.length and balanceOf[_to] += _value inside the batchSend loop: unchecked multiplication/addition
token*(10**uint256(decimals)) and maxToken*(10**uint256(decimals)) in init: unchecked exponentiation and multiplication
whitelist bypass in ensure(): privileged addresses skip the condition() sale-limit checks entirely

edges.reason: constructor sets owner = msg.sender, so the privileged role is derived from caller input
constructor uses msg.sender for owner, minted balance and router allowance
transferFrom reads allowance[_from][msg.sender] and mutates it with caller-controlled value
transfer forwards msg.sender as the _from argument of transferFrom
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] from caller-controlled state
delegate() requires msg.sender == owner before the delegatecall
init() requires msg.sender == owner before configuring sale limits
batchSend() requires msg.sender == owner before distributing tokens
setTradeAddress() requires msg.sender == owner before writing tradeAddress
msg.sender is the only guard protecting the arbitrary delegatecall
transfer delegates all state changes to transferFrom
transferFrom calls ensure(_from,_to,_value) before mutating balances
transferFrom reaches condition() transitively through ensure()
transferFrom performs raw subtraction and addition on allowance and balances
transferFrom reads and writes balanceOf[_from] and balanceOf[_to]
transferFrom reads and decrements the allowance mapping
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from] after every transfer
ensure grants an unconditional bypass of condition() to owner, UNI, tradeAddress and canSale addresses
ensure calls condition(_from,_value) when the whitelist does not match
ensure computes the expected pair address via pairFor to whitelist it
ensure compares _from against the state variable tradeAddress
ensure consults the canSale whitelist mapping
whitelist bypass compares _from/_to against the privileged owner address
condition reads _minSale to reject small sales
condition reads _maxSale to reject large sales
condition reads _saleNum to enforce per-address sale counts
condition compares _onSaleNum[_from] against _saleNum
init computes token*(10**decimals) and maxToken*(10**decimals) without overflow checks
init writes _minSale
init writes _maxSale
init writes _saleNum
batchSend computes total = _value * length and accumulates balanceOf[_to] += _value unchecked
batchSend reads and writes the balanceOf mapping in a loop
batchSend emits transfer events referencing the canonical router constant as a beneficiary context
delegate() passes attacker-supplied address and calldata directly into the delegatecall
setTradeAddress writes the tradeAddress whitelist entry used by ensure
constructor initialises owner from msg.sender
constructor assigns the full supply to balanceOf[msg.sender]
constructor grants an unlimited allowance to the Uniswap router
constructor sets totalSupply

constructor sets the symbol state variable

batchSend gate compares msg.sender against owner

delegate gate compares msg.sender against owner
